I identified a critical bug in the per-deployment alert rate calculation. The current implementation incorrectly calculates the alert rate for each deployment as `stats.alerts / self.scored` (total alerts in deployment divided by total trajectories across all deployments) rather than `stats.alerts / stats.scored` (alerts in deployment divided by trajectories in that deployment).
